name: Another Morning Owe to You
source:
4 months after your former boyfriend's death, you finally decided to visit him one last time as well as the apartment you both used to live together. There, you found one last gift from him that you'll eventually bring along on your move to a new place to start a new life, hoping to leave the past behind; however, whether you actually moved on, or stayed in the past would depend on your choices you make.

[From [url=https://leiphory.itch.io/another-morning-owe-to-you]itch.io[/url]]
